description: Cases and correct look-alikes of the practical fixture built by build.py (spec 010). Lines are 1-based and refer to the feature branch; each entry is located by anchor, a substring on exactly one line of its file. A finding matches an entry when the files are equal and the entry line lies within three lines of the finding range. Cases are scored by the criterion named in expect, not by recall.

cases.expect: SC-002: reported with severity at most medium and trigger class operator-change or release; in_practice names a release or a configuration change between deployments.
SC-003: reported under Design questions (kind design-question), not among defects, in at least 4 of 5 runs.
SC-004: any finding here that quotes SEARCH_GENERATIONS=5 carries a value correction to .env line 3 (SEARCH_GENERATIONS=10), or is refuted as unreachable in the shipped configurations.

lookalikes.expect: Not reported: the cache key holds every input of the cached value.
Not reported: the lookup rebuilds a summary stored under an older schema.
